{"metadata":{"description":"A theme that completely replaces the Web interface of DeepSeek Harness with the H.D.D terminal theme of "Fairy" from the game "Zenless Zone Zero", including the boot animation","id":"gh:1430547172","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"fairy-zzz-plugin","slug":"AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-theme"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A theme that completely replaces the Web interface of DeepSeek Harness with the H.D.D terminal theme"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" of "Fairy" from the game "Zenless Zone Zero", including the boot animation"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Fairy Ⅲ · 绝区零 H.D.D 皮肤"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**中文** · English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"把 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面换成《绝区零》Fairy 的 H.D.D 终端：满屏开机动画 → 居中问好 → 收成会话区左侧的常驻眼徽，并可用本地 GPT-SoVITS 的 F"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ness 的 Web 界面换成《绝区零》Fairy 的 H.D.D 终端：满屏开机动画 → 居中问好 → 收成会话区左侧的常驻眼徽，并可用本地 GPT-SoVITS 的 Fairy 音色把回复念出来。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| 眼徽状态 | 设置面板 |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 特性"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **开机动画**：整屏播放 H.D.D 启动片，视频按 `object-fit: contain` 完整显示，多余区域由同帧的模糊铺底填充，任何窗口比例都不会出现硬黑边。启动片自带音轨：页面允许自"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"动播放时直接带声音放，被浏览器拦下就先静音播放，等你第一次点按/敲键再把声音打开。
- **居中问好**：动画结束后淡入 H.D.D 眼徽（深蓝环 / 白盘 / 蓝瞳 / 高光点），背后是蓝光晕图，`"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"HOLLOW DEEP DIVE SYSTEM` 标题带镜面倒影，下方按当前时段（凌晨/上午/中午/下午/傍晚/深夜）播一句问候并同步播放预录音频。
- **收成眼徽**：问候结束约 1.9s 后眼徽"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"飞到会话区左缘的中线（侧栏右侧的蓝色圈内）常驻，光晕图淡出。默认可以按住拖到屏幕任意位置，坐标写进 `localStorage`，刷新后仍在原位；不想要拖动就去 `设置 → Fairy` 关掉「拖动眼"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"徽」，或用「眼标复位」回到会话区左缘。
- **用量气泡**：单击眼徽弹出一个小气泡，显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、今天的花费（按百万 token 折算，含缓存命中/未命中/输出三段拆分）和当前是"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"高峰还是空闲时段（带倒计时，直接告诉你还有多久换价）；再点一下收起。每轮对话跑完会自动弹一次，这时只报「本轮花费 + 峰谷」，不显示余额与今日合计，18 秒后自己消失。拖动眼徽时气泡跟着走，靠到窗口右"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"缘会自动翻到眼徽左侧。峰谷按官方现行规则算：**北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为高峰，其余时间（含周末与法定节假日全天）为空闲、价格减半**；倒计时归零时气泡会自"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"动重新拉一次数据。价格表在 `index.js` 的 `PRICES`，时段与节假日表在 `peakState()` / `HOLIDAY_RANGES`，跨年记得补一行假期。花费按每笔请求发生那一刻"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"的价档结算，白天的高峰用量不会被夜里的半价「折算」掉。
- **状态动效**（复刻参考实现 Fairy-DSH 的几何与时长）：
- `idle` 呼吸 + 缓慢自转 + 扫描光带；
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"需要 DeepSeek Harness（插件只在运行时调用宿主提供的槽位与 webServer，不直接 import `@deepseek-ai/*`）。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**方式一：让 agent 装（推荐）**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"然后在 DSH 会话里："},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**方式二：手动合并 patch**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"把本仓库根目录 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的**两个** `insert` 段一起合并进你的 profile patch（Windows 一般是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"profiles\<profile>\cordis.patch.yml`）："},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"装好后整页刷新一次。皮肤只做「插入一行 + 宿主注册两条 HTTP 路由」，不修改宿主的任何文件。"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**方式三：Windows 一键脚本**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"脚本会自己找 profile、把插件放进 `node_modules\dsh-fairy-zzz`、补 patch、把浅色主题改成深色。不放心脚本改文件的话用方式一/二。"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> **从旧版升级**：1.0.0 起包名从 `@local/dsh-fairy-zzz` 改成 `dsh-fairy-zzz`（为了能被收录与 npm 安装）。
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 已知限制"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- 官方字标是内联 SVG，没有可替换的文本节点；`sidebar.brand.mark/name` 又是 `single` 槽位、宿主先注册者常驻，所以皮肤用「隐藏官方字标 + 在同一位置叠自己的字"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"标」来实现，不是真正的槽位替换。官方的 DOM 结构一改就可能要跟着调选择器。
- 桌面壳的窗口标题、菜单、侧栏条目文案属于应用本身，插件改不了。
- 新建对话页的标题与徽章没有插槽可换，皮肤直接改写"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" DOM 文本，并用 900ms 的低频定时器兜底重刷；官方若把它们改成多节点或富文本结构，选择器要跟着调。
- 与其它抢占左下/右下角落的插件（鲸鱼挂件、桌宠）同时开时观感会打架。
- 语音只有仓库"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"自带的一条问候；逐句朗读要自备 Fairy 语音包（见上面语音章节），引擎和权重都不在仓库里。
- 语音引擎是可选外部依赖，仓库不含权重与引擎本体。"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Boot animation** — the H.D.D startup clip fills the screen with `object-fit: contain`, and the l"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"eftover area is filled with a blurred copy of the same frame, so no hard black bars appear at any wi"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ndow ratio. The clip carries its own audio track: it plays with sound when the page allows autoplay,"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" otherwise it starts muted and unmutes on your first click or keypress.
- **Centered greeting** — wh"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"en the clip ends, the H.D.D eye badge (deep-blue ring / white disc / blue iris / highlight dot) fade"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"s in over a blue glow, with a mirrored `HOLLOW DEEP DIVE SYSTEM` title and a time-of-day greeting (s"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"mall hours / morning / noon / afternoon / evening / late night) played together with a matching pre-"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"recorded audio clip.
- **Badge hand-off** — about 1.9 s after the greeting the badge flies to the mi"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"ddle of the left edge of the conversation area (inside the blue ring next to the sidebar) and stays "},{"id":"p25s10","text":"there while the glow fades out. It is draggable by default: hold it and move it anywhere on screen —"},{"id":"p25s11","text":" the position is stored in `localStorage` and survives a reload. Turn "Draggable badge" off under *S"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"ettings → Fairy*, or use "Reset badge" to snap it back to the left edge of the conversation area.
[该"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"s → Fairy*, or use "Reset badge" to snap it back to the left edge of the conversation area.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- The official wordmark is inline SVG with no replaceable text node, and `sidebar.brand.mark/name` a"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"re `single` slots that the first registrant keeps, so the skin hides the official wordmark and overl"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ays its own at the same position instead of doing a real slot replacement. If the official DOM chang"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"es, the selectors may need updating.
- The desktop shell's window title, menus and sidebar labels be"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"long to the app itself; a plugin cannot change them.
- Other plugins that claim the bottom-left/righ"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"t corners (whale widget, desktop pet) may look cluttered when enabled together.
- The voice engine i"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"s an optional external dependency; the repository ships neither weights nor the engine itself, and i"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"t contains just one pre-recorded greeting — speaking every reply needs your own Fairy voice pack."}],"truncated":true}
